extracted.name: Marinara Sauce
extracted.description: This classic Marinara Sauce recipe only uses 6 ingredients and can be made with fresh or canned tomatoes. It only takes 20 minutes to make, and is so flavorful and versatile.
ingredient_lines: 28 ounce can whole San Marzano tomatoes*
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
instruction_lines: Crush the tomatoes with your hands into a large bowl. Set aside.

Add oil to a large skillet over medium heat. Once hot, add the garlic. Stir and then add the crushed tomatoes, oregano, basil, sugar, and salt. Reduce to a simmer and cook for at least 15-20 minutes, until the oil on the surface turns a deep orange.
